title: 第100章：是时候摊牌了！
slug: 流放路上捡破烂两岁萌娃养肥全家

第(1/3)页

“大勇，撑住！”

秦昭岚的话刚出口，上方突然传来一阵“哒哒”声。

她循声抬头，只见安安去而复返。

“安安，你怎么回来了？”

“娘亲，我刚才听见马蹄声了。我担心你和叔叔们，就回来啦！”

苏安安站在石梯上，看了看秦昭岚，又看向被围困的刘大勇等人。

为首的将领看见她，冷哼一声：“来了就跟你娘一起死！”

“死不好，安安不死，娘亲和叔叔们也不死！”苏安安摆了摆小手。

将领没耐心地皱起眉头，“死丫头真啰嗦，去给我杀了她！”

“怎么又要杀我呀？”苏安安不高兴地瘪嘴。

虽然她想收回他们的武器，可她现在变强了，不用被动等着被杀了。

见有士兵冲上来，她心念一动，附近几名士兵们手中的武器和身上的衣裳、鞋子，全都消失了。

士兵们感觉身上一凉，低头一看，全都慌张地捂住仅剩的一条裤衩。

“我的衣裳呢？”

“我的武器也不见了。”

“在呢，在我这里哦！”苏安安拍了拍自己的胸口，“但我不会还给你们哒！”

“死丫头，没有武器老子也能杀了你！”

说着，一名士兵冲上前。

苏安安眨了眨眼，拿起刚兑换的小炮仗，扔在士兵的脚边。

小炮仗刚落地，就发出一声炸响，吓得士兵往后退了一步，从石梯上滚了下去。

“啊！”

士兵痛呼一声，摔在石梯下直“哎哟”。

苏安安小嘴一咧，兴奋地鼓掌。

“嘻嘻，坏蛋滚咯！”

“我怎么感觉这个小丫头有些邪门？”

士兵们看向苏安安，不敢上前。

刘大勇趁士兵们走神，连忙对着大家招了招手，领着他们从另一侧的副井离开。

“头儿，不好了，他们跑了！”

一名士兵发现刘大勇等人不见了，急得皱紧眉头。

将领不屑冷哼，“他们跑不远！等解决完这对母女，再上去杀了他们！”

“你们才杀不了我呢！”苏安安摇了摇小脑袋，转身往上跑，边跑边喊道：“娘亲快上来呀！”

秦昭岚不知道她要做什么，一脚踹开缠着她的将领。

将领没有防备，被踢得往后退了几步。

士兵快速上前，一把扶住他。

“追，别让他们跑了！”

"Dayong, hold on!"

As soon as Qin Zhaolan finished speaking, there was a sudden "ta-da" sound from above.

She looked up following the sound and saw An An leaving and returning.

"An'an, why are you back?"

"Mom, I just heard the sound of horse hooves. I was worried about you and my uncles, so I came back!"

Su Anan stood on the stone staircase, looked at Qin Zhaolan, and then looked at the besieged Liu Dayong and others.

The leading general saw her and snorted coldly: "I will die with your mother when I come!"

"It's not good to die. If An An doesn't die, neither will my mother and uncles!" Su Anan waved her little hand.

The general frowned impatiently, "You damn girl is so verbose, go kill her for me!"

"Why do you want to kill me again?" Su Anan frowned unhappily.

Although she wanted to take back their weapons, she was stronger now and no longer had to wait passively to be killed.

Seeing soldiers rushing up, she thought, and the weapons in the hands of the nearby soldiers and the clothes and shoes on their bodies all disappeared.

The soldiers felt a chill on their bodies. When they looked down, they all covered their only remaining pair of pants in a panic.

"Where are my clothes?"

"My weapons are gone too."

"Here he is, here with me!" Su Anan patted her chest, "But I won't give it back to you!"

"Damn girl, I can kill you without a weapon!"

As he spoke, a soldier rushed forward.

Su Anan blinked, picked up the small firecrackers he had just exchanged, and threw them at the soldiers' feet.

As soon as the small firecracker hit the ground, there was an explosion, which scared the soldiers back a step and rolled down the stone stairs.

"Ah!"

The soldier cried out in pain and fell down the stone staircase and said "Ouch".

Su Anan grinned and clapped excitedly.

"Hee hee, get out of here, bad guy!"

"Why do I feel like there's something evil about this little girl?"

The soldiers looked at Su Anan and did not dare to step forward.

Liu Dayong took advantage of the soldiers' distraction, quickly waved to everyone, and led them away from the auxiliary shaft on the other side.

"Boss, no, they ran away!"

A soldier frowned anxiously when he discovered that Liu Dayong and others were missing.

The general snorted disdainfully, "They can't run far! Wait until you finish dealing with the mother and daughter, then go up and kill them!"

"You can't kill me!" Su Anan shook her little head, turned around and ran up, shouting as she ran: "Mom, come up quickly!"

Qin Zhaolan didn't know what she was going to do, so she kicked away the general who was pestering her.

The general was unprepared and was kicked back a few steps.

The soldier quickly stepped forward and supported him.

"Chase, don't let them escape!"
